PR10: Documentation and delivery gates (#139)

* PR10: Documentation and delivery gates

* PR10: describe delivery status as open stack pending ordered merge

* PR10: map installed Flutter SDK for melos and document the linear stack

The dyn-workflow installed Flutter under FLUTTER_ROOT but melos.yaml
requires .fvm/flutter_sdk, so just check failed before running. Symlink
the installed SDK to the melos path after setup, and update the delivery
status to describe the linear stack with all review fixes rebased in order
(892s, 8939).

* PR10: isolate dyn-workflow state per source ref and report conclusions

The shared dynamic branch previously let concurrent source-branch pushes
overwrite ref.txt and cancel one another. The check workflow now keys its
concurrency group by the trigger SHA (each dynamic-branch push is its own
trigger commit with its own branch/commit/ref metadata), verifies the
checked-out source commit matches the trigger's recorded commit before
running, and posts the downstream conclusion back to the source commit as
the plate/check status so the PR surfaces the run that tested its head.
The runbook Delivery Status documents the isolation and the requirement
that the final gate is reconciled only by a completed run whose metadata
is exactly pr-10 at the final integrated head.

* PR10: pin the dyn-workflow Flutter SDK and post the full commit SHA

The downstream run installed the latest stable Flutter (3.44.8) while the
workspace pins 3.41.4 via .fvmrc, so the committed baseline goldens failed
rasterization on every run. Setup Flutter now reads flutter-version-file:
.fvmrc, so CI uses exactly the SDK the goldens were generated with. The
conclusion status was also rejected because commit.txt records the short
SHA; the verify step now resolves the full object id for the status API.

* PR10: re-post the dyn-workflow state on the final integrated head
